newsitem.title: UK: Man replaces cocoa director, unit in H1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Man replaces cocoa director, unit in H1 loss.

text.p: ED & F Man, the British-based commodity and financial services firm, said on Thursday it was replacing the head of its cocoa division, and the business would be under the management of Anthony Stillitano from today.
"Michael Metcalf, chairman of cocoa, is resigning from the board with effect from today," Man said in a statement accompanying its results for the half year to September 30.
It gave no other details of the personnel change.
Its results showed the cocoa business slipped into a first half pretax loss of 4.5 million stg, compared with a profit of 0.5 million stg in the same year-ago period.

"Uncertainty in the London cocoa market has caused pricing difficulties, particularly with forward contracts," the group said, explaining that European levels of customer activity were much reduced as a result.

Losses in Europe ensued, though it did not quantify these, saying only that contributions from its North American and Brazilian businesses were less disrupted by these factors and made positive contributions to the cocoa division.
Man said its Singapore cocoa office, opened in June, "had made an encouraging start".
